title: Mellow Yellow | KEY.co
description_expanded: Upstairs, the home continues to impress with three serene bedrooms—including two spacious king suites and a charming bunk room that opens onto a breezy second-floor porch with treetop views, a hammock, and a swing for laid-back lounging. Every space feels intentional, from the marble-drenched primary bath to the thoughtful porch access points throughout. With space for the whole family and then some, this coastal retreat offers the perfect balance of privacy, charm, and location—just 489 feet from the beach and a short stroll to Seaside’s iconic shops and restaurants. Whether it’s a quick getaway or a long-awaited reunion, this is the kind of home where memories are made.
